description: What the agent does with the text a provider streams: token and token_reset events for the task, the pieces masked like the answer the task keeps.

mutations.name: AG1
mutations.what: the agent does not hand a reset callback to the provider

mutations.name: AG2
mutations.what: a reset is announced as another kind of event

mutations.name: AG3
mutations.what: a reset does not say which task it is for

mutations.name: AG4
mutations.what: the text of an answer is not forwarded to the watchers

mutations.name: AG5
mutations.what: the pieces of text are announced as another kind of event

patches.old: emit: (token) => { this.#emit({ type: 'token', taskId: task.id, token }); },
patches.new: emit: (token) => { this.#emit({ type: 'text', taskId: task.id, token }); },

mutations.name: AG6
mutations.what: the pieces are sent as the model sent them, unmasked

patches.new: onToken: (token) => { this.#emit({ type: 'token', taskId: task.id, token }); },

mutations.name: AG7
mutations.what: the held end of the answer is never sent

mutations.name: AG8
mutations.what: the pieces are masked without the secrets the Hub knows

mutations.name: AG9
mutations.what: the pieces are not masked at all
